rule: Actual frozen IQ2_S/Q2_0 dequant + production XMX GU/SwiGLU/down versus offline BF16 singleU4 + S4x2, fused FP16-rounded/saturated SwiGLU/S4 pack. Three main experts, normal and outlier inputs, full GU/Y finite errors versus original BF16 expert chain; W4 final NRMSE must be no worse than current IQ/Q2 in all declared cases. All packed bytes bind to GPU BF16 repack; full fused/separate pack equality, guards/tails. Resident and pinned-host streamed complete-chain wall times separate;24 changing physical banks,one wait/eight experts,activation pack and H2D included every call. Warm8 batches then8 ABBA cycles x24calls per arm. Stable requires each arm drift<=3%;6of8stable and median gain>=10% for an individual shape; screen and independent confirm.
